items_missed: 1_set_agenda: never asked 'how are you today,' never confirmed the September 4th move-date availability she raised, no upfront agenda statement, no explicit 'sound good?' confirmation.

2_probe: no zip codes for origin or destination, never proactively asked about narrow hallways/tight turns or destination stairs (she had to raise the curved staircase herself near the end), no storage question, no access/parking/HOA question, never asked the direct 'anything you're worried about with this move' stressor question.
3_pricing: no full itemized 'no hidden fees' pitch (credit card fee, fuel surcharge, assembly fee) — only a general 'no additional fees outside of that.'
4_clock: no 'does that make sense?' sense-check after walking through the clock.

5_estimate: didn't tie stairs/elevator or specialty items (the safe, the adjustable bed) back to the estimate as variables, no walk-distance mention, no equivalents (school bus, etc.), no traffic caveat.
6_save_your_ass: the entire prep speech is missing — no mention that packing ahead shortens the move and lowers the bill, no consolidation examples, no 'take a carload' tip, no close.

7_quote_booking: no attempt to book/schedule today, never mentioned no deposit required, didn't ask her to reply with corrections to verify details, never asked 'any other questions before I let you go,' never gave hours or how to reach the branch.
8_politeness: used her name only once ('Patty') instead of 3+ times.

9_bonus: explained No Worries coverage well but never mentioned the 60 cent/lb baseline valuation alternative; when she said she had one competing quote higher and one lower, he let that pass with no budget-conscious value pitch back.
top_strength: The differentiators pitch was clean and fully unprompted — he walked through No Worries Damage Coverage, the Meet Your Mover email, and the On-Time Guarantee back-to-back without her asking, framing them as 'some of the cool features that you do receive being one of our clients.'
coaching_note: Your differentiators pitch is genuinely strong — On-Time Guarantee, Meet Your Mover, and No Worries all landed clean. But two of the highest-value sections are just missing: there's no agenda statement telling her what the call covers, and you never gave the Save Your Ass prep speech at all — that's 10 points sitting on the table on every call. When she told you she had a quote higher and a quote lower than yours, that was your moment to build value and you let it go by. Tighten the close too: ask to book today, mention no deposit, and use her name more than once.
phone_presence_notes: Patient through two computer freezes and a mid-call audio dropout, and warm in the ChatGPT moment, but most of the call runs as a rapid-fire inventory checklist with mechanical transitions and only one use of her name.
audio_review_reason: Both parties reference real audio/connection problems mid-call ('you're cutting out,' 'I can't hear you,' rep's computer freezing twice) — this is a genuine call-quality issue, not just thin ASR, so tone during that stretch should be verified against the actual recording.
